2609.08887.title: Q2D-Web: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Retrieval in Agentic RAG Systems
2609.08887.paper_summary: Evaluating first-stage retrievers in large-scale production RAG requires a benchmark that pairs a large-scale corpus with a large set of agent-reformulated search queries based on real user queries and their conversation threads, and that labels many relevant documents per query. No existing public benchmark evaluates this setting: large-scale collections typically provide only a small number of evaluation queries, whereas benchmarks with many queries generally contain only millions of documents. Moreover, most benchmarks assess human-written queries, while the first-stage retrievers in agentic RAG pipelines serve machine-written reformulations whose distribution differs from human search behavior. To overcome these evaluation gaps, we introduce Q2D-Web (Query2Doc-Web), a large-scale agentic retrieval benchmark consisting of a 190M-document web corpus and 70k agentic search queries in ten languages, reformulated from real-world user queries in production systems. Q2D-Web provides three sets of fixed relevance judgments: agent citations, production rankings, and a combined set that unions both signals and adds LLM-based judgments of unlabeled pooled documents to reduce false negatives. We benchmark 13 retrievers including lexical, dense, and late-interaction models and find that their relative ordering is largely insensitive to the choice of judgment set, while diverging substantially across topical domains, query languages, and query types. To enable fast evaluation, we also study subcorpus sampling as an approximation to full-corpus evaluations. Retaining a third of the corpus, selected by reciprocal rank fusion over pooled retriever runs, preserves the full-corpus model ranking under the combined judgments while raising absolute Recall@1000 only by 3 to 7 points. The public leaderboard is accessible under: https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard
2609.08887.paper_summary_zh: 評估大型生產 RAG 中的第一階段檢索器需要一個基準，該基準將大型語料庫與基於真實用戶查詢及其對話線程的大量代理重新表述的搜索查詢配對，並為每個查詢標記許多相關文檔。現有的公共基準沒有評估這種設置：大型集合通常僅提供少量的評估查詢，而擁有許多查詢的基準一般僅包含數百萬個文檔。此外，大多數基準評估人類撰寫的查詢，而代理 RAG 管道中的第一階段檢索器則服務於機器撰寫的重新表述，其分佈與人類搜索行為不同。為了克服這些評估差距，我們推出了 Q2D-Web（Query2Doc-Web），這是一個大型代理檢索基準，包含一個 1.9 億文檔的網絡語料庫和 70,000 個來自生產系統的真實用戶查詢重新表述的代理搜索查詢，涵蓋十種語言。Q2D-Web 提供三組固定的相關性判斷：代理引用、生產排名，以及一組結合了這兩種信號並添加了基於 LLM 的未標記合併文檔判斷的綜合集，以減少假陰性。我們基準測試了 13 個檢索器，包括詞彙、密集和後期交互模型，發現它們的相對排序對判斷集的選擇大致不敏感，但在主題領域、查詢語言和查詢類型之間有顯著差異。為了實現快速評估，我們還研究了子語料庫抽樣作為完整語料庫評估的近似方法。保留三分之一的語料庫，通過對合併檢索器運行的互惠排名融合選擇，可以在綜合判斷下保留完整語料庫模型的排名，同時將 Recall@1000 的絕對值僅提高 3 到 7 分。公共排行榜可在以下網址訪問：https://huggingface.co/spaces/perplexity-ai/q2d-web-leaderboard
